itinerary.title: Departure from Cairo to Bahariya
itinerary.source: The tour opens with a departure from Cairo after breakfast and a four-hour drive southwest into the Western Desert.

itinerary.title: Black Mountains, Salt Lake, White Desert
itinerary.source: Camp is set up here, beneath the formations and the open sky.

itinerary.title: Crystal Mountain, Agabat, Black Desert
itinerary.source: The day closes back in Bahariya, a last night at the oasis before the long push west.

itinerary.title: The long road to Siwa
itinerary.source: You arrive in the evening, and the night is for rest before a full day in the oasis.

itinerary.title: Shali Fortress, Oracle of Amun, Cleopatra's Spring
itinerary.source: Siwa's history is denser than it first looks, and the fifth day works down through it.

itinerary.title: Into the Great Sand Sea
itinerary.source: You return to Siwa in the early evening.

itinerary.title: Mountain of the Dead, drive to Cairo
itinerary.source: Lunch in Siwa, then the long drive back to Cairo, arriving in the evening.
